d: All-in-one video device for Zoom/Teams/BYOD. Supports small to medium rooms up to 10 people within 15ft/5m.*Requires NEATPAD-SE, **VESA Display Mount sold separately

specs.label: Camera
specs.value: Wide camera: 50 MP, ƒ/2.8 aperture, 113° horizontal field of view

specs.label: Microphones
specs.value: 5 microphones angled in an end-fire array; 4 tracking and sensor mics

specs.label: Audio processing
specs.value: Echo cancellation, noise suppression, automatic gain control, dereverberation

specs.label: Platforms
specs.value: Native support for Zoom Rooms and Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android

specs.label: Ports
